panels.subject_action: protagonist kneeling before the stele, one hand reaching out to touch the carved runes, head tilted in shock or recognition, missing person's backpack visible at their side
panels.camera: close-up over-the-shoulder shot, shallow depth, the stele dominating frame center, the protagonist's silhouette in foreground
panels.lighting: single cold-blue light source from the stele itself, the protagonist's face half-lit, rim light on the backpack, surrounding chamber falling into deep black
panels.mood: revelation, dread, the moment the level's true premise becomes clear
panels.player_intent: 揭示守护者并非反派而是封印者，反转玩家对前面战斗的道德判断

panels.title: 钟楼对峙
panels.scene: the top of the temple bell tower, massive bronze bell hanging center frame fully intact, panoramic moonlit view of the broken temple complex below, mountain mist surrounding the tower base, wooden support beams crisscrossing dramatically
panels.subject_action: protagonist and the guardian facing each other across the bell, both weapons lowered slightly, the guardian's posture defensive rather than aggressive, the bell rope swaying between them as a visual barrier
panels.camera: symmetrical two-shot composition, level eye-line, slight upward tilt to include sky, the bell as the geometric and dramatic center
panels.lighting: high-key moonlight from above through open tower structure, cool ambient light, soft rim light on both figures, the bell catching the brightest highlight
panels.mood: uneasy ceasefire, mutual recognition, the eye of the storm before final choice
